ProjectSpecification__Description: TEMPLATE. Copy this file to a project’s 30__TrueVision__AppContent folder as TrueVision__DrawingNotes__.json, beside TrueVision__ProjectData__.json. It is the local drawing-notes document TrueVision keeps in sync with the same filename on R2. Groups hold notes in order; a note’s code is its group’s prefix and its place in the group (GN01, FN01), recomputed on every load. Specification bubbles on Layout Editor sheets link by Note__Id, not by code. Group__IsGeneral notes are listed on every sheet’s notes margin after the notes that sheet’s bubbles link to. LastIdNumber only ever goes up, so a deleted note’s id is never reused. A local edit should set ProjectSpecification__UpdatedIso so the app treats this copy as newer than R2. Replace the example groups and notes below.

Group__Notes.Note__Body: Replace this with a project-wide note. It appears on every sheet that has a notes margin.
A specification bubble with Leader__SpecNoteId SpecNote_002 shows FN01 and lists this body in that sheet’s notes margin.
